title: Deterministic list work budget
statement: Let the output dimension be a positive integer $n$, let the requested bias be a positive rational number at most $1/2$, and let the integral Fourier $1$-norm bound be an integer at least $1$. Define the list work budget as the restricted-weight construction work plus $n$ times the stage work budget.
